s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic abdominal pain, vaginal discharge, and urinary and bowel symptoms
key_facts: Previous attempted myomectomy with severe adhesions
Elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level of 115.6 g/dL
Transabdominal ultrasound showed a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity
Abdominal and pelvic computed tomography demonstrated a multilocular cystic mass

raw.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with chronic abdominal pain, vaginal discharge, and urinary and bowel symptoms
key_facts: Previous attempted myomectomy with severe adhesions
Elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level of 115.6 g/dL
Transabdominal ultrasound showed a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity
Abdominal and pelvic computed tomography demonstrated a multilocular cystic mass

differentials: Clear cell carcinoma of the ovary
Small cell carcinoma of the ovary
per_call: Clear cell carcinoma of the ovary
Small cell carcinoma of the ovary

shortlist.label: Infected hematometra
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge, fluctuating lower abdominal pain, and a pelvic mass, with imaging studies showing a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity and a multilocular cystic mass

shortlist.label: Intraligamentary myoma with cystic degeneration
shortlist.why_kept: Transabdominal ultrasound and abdominal and pelvic computed tomography demonstrated a solid mass in the left adnexa with a clear border, consistent with a myoma

shortlist.label: Ovarian fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a pelvic mass and imaging studies showing a solid mass in the left adnexa, which could be consistent with an ovarian fibroma

shortlist.label: Endometrial carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of postmenopausal bleeding, elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level, and a pelvic mass, which could be consistent with endometrial carcinoma

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of progressive abdominal enlargement, difficulty with defecation and voiding, and a pelvic mass, which could be consistent with a uterine leiomyosarcoma

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of brown-yellowish vaginal discharge, fluctuating lower abdominal pain, fever, and progressive abdominal enlargement, combined with the imaging findings of a hypoechoic mass within the uterine cavity and a distended uterine cavity with fluid and air, are most consistent with infected hematometra.

rejected.label: Intraligamentary myoma with cystic degeneration
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of myomectomy and severe adhesions, the current symptoms and imaging findings are more suggestive of an infected uterine condition rather than a myoma.

rejected.label: Ovarian fibroma
rejected.why: The imaging findings do not specifically suggest an ovarian fibroma, and the patient's symptoms are more consistent with a uterine condition.

rejected.label: Endometrial carcinoma
rejected.why: While the elevated Cancer Antigen 125 level is concerning for malignancy, the patient's symptoms and imaging findings are more consistent with an infected hematometra, and there is no definitive evidence of endometrial carcinoma.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence to suggest uterine leiomyosarcoma, and the patient's symptoms and imaging findings are more consistent with infected hematometra.
